newsitem.title: JAPAN: JVC sees 97/98 parent current continuing to rise.
newsitem.headline: JVC sees 97/98 parent current continuing to rise.

text.p: Victor Co of Japan Ltd (JVC) said on Monday that it expects its parent current profit to continue to rise in the year to March 31, 1998.
A company spokesman said the expected rise was due to JVC's efforts to restructure its business in recent years, but he did not give specific profit forecasts for 1997/98.
He said, however, that JVC's parent sales in 1996/97 would be between 575 billion and 580 billion yen, compared with an October forecast of 590 billion yen.
But the company maintained the forecast it made in October of a 1996/97 parent current profit of eight billion yen, he said.
In 1995/96, JVC posted a parent current profit of 5.54 billion yen on sales of 562.59 billion yen.
